components.name: Outlined Decision Buttons
components.description: Equal-weight opposing choices; the disabled styling applies to both when acknowledgments are incomplete.
components.css: .ds-decision-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; } .ds-decision-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 60px; padding: 13px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.55; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-decision-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-tint, #f0f4fa); border-color: var(--color-cobalt-deep, #1739b9); color: var(--color-cobalt-deep, #1739b9); } .ds-decision-button:active:not(:disabled) { background: #e5ecff; } .ds-decision-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-decision-button:disabled { color: var(--color-muted, #52647a); border-color: var(--color-control, #7488a3); background: var(--color-canvas, #fafbfc); cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-decision-actions { gap: var(--space-3, 12px); } .ds-decision-button { padding-inline: 15px; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-decision-actions { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-decision-button { transition-duration: 0s !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A quiet source or history action with deep-cobalt color and an underline revealed on hover or press.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); padding: 8px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-text-action:hover, .ds-text-action:active { color: var(--color-cobalt-deep, #1739b9); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-action:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text-action { transition-duration: 0s !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.css: .ds-message-field { color: var(--color-ink, #171d25); font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 7px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-message-input { display: block; resize: vertical; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; border: 1px solid var(--color-control, #7488a3); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: var(--space-3, 12px); color: var(--color-ink, #171d25); background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-message-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-error, #a22231); } .ds-message-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field-error { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-error, #a22231); font-size: 13px; } .ds-field-help { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted, #52647a); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Indexed Section Navigation

components.css: .ds-section-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: var(--space-4, 16px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #dce4ef); padding-bottom: 17px; font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-section-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; color: var(--color-muted, #52647a); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-section-index { color: var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-section-link:hover, .ds-section-link:active { color: var(--color-cobalt-deep, #1739b9); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-section-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-section-nav { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px 20px; padding-bottom: 14px; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-section-link { font-size: 12px; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); } }

components.css: .ds-included-note { display: flex; gap: var(--space-4, 16px); padding: 19px 22px; background: var(--color-tint, #f0f4fa); color: var(--color-ink, #171d25); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #dce4ef); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); font-family: var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-info-icon { width: 21px; height: 21px; flex: 0 0 21px; margin-top: 1px; stroke: var(--color-cobalt, #244ee8); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-included-heading { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-included-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 28px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0 0 17px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-included-item { padding-left: 1px; } .ds-included-help { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 75ch; color: var(--color-muted, #52647a); font-size: 12px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-included-note { padding: 17px 15px; gap: 11px; } .ds-included-list { display: block; } .ds-included-item + .ds-included-item { margin-top: 3px; } }

narrative.overview:
A light, cool-white studio-specification interface: dark readable system sans, restrained cobalt, crisp fine rules, and flat tonal layering. Precision comes from aligned information, meaningful indices, and familiar controls rather than decorative display type or financial-dashboard styling.

The voice is neutral and non-adversarial. Separate current information from historical context, make attribution readable, and give opposing decisions equal visual weight. This record describes the built synthetic client-review interface, not production completeness, financial permissions, or established accessibility conformance.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-white surfaces with ink text and restrained cobalt.
Fine rules, compact indices, and tabular amounts.
Flat tonal layering and gently squared controls.
Familiar native interactions and explicit preview staging.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt to identify actions, focus, and meaningful indices; do not turn an approval into a filled brand-primary button.

rules.name: The Flat Material Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tone, rules, and spacing, not decorative elevation.

dos: **Do** retain the system UI stack, ink text, and cool-white material.
**Do** use fine rules, aligned labels, and tabular amounts to make comparisons readable.
**Do** keep opposing decisions equal in weight, size, and availability.
**Do** preserve visible focus, native controls, and the reduced-motion override.
**Do** maintain at least 44px by 44px hit areas for standalone controls and checkbox labels, without overlapping neighboring targets.
**Do** distinguish current information, attributed evidence, history, and local previews.
donts: **Don't** introduce display fonts, gradients, decorative shadows, or filled approval primaries.
**Don't** turn informational chips or included-work items into selectable controls.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate status, error, or authority.
**Don't** treat generated tonal ramps or one-off measurements as an implemented scale.
**Don't** present synthetic previews as recorded outcomes or claim accessibility conformance.
